title: Common affine étale object models
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D : I^{op} \to \mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-affine-morphism, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $c$ be a limiting cone. For any $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and family $X_a$, $a \in \mathrm{Fin}(m)$, of full affine étale objects over $c.pt$ [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site], there are a stage $i$ and affine étale objects $X_{i,a}$ over $D_i$, with morphisms $r_a : X_a \to X_{i,a}$ such that the square with structure morphisms to $c.pt$ and $D_i$, and the cone projection, is a pullback [def-pc-fibre-product]. The empty family is allowed.

proof.text:
Every affine étale object has finitely presented structure morphism because
its source is quasi-compact and its base is quasi-separated. The limit is qcqs since
its projections are affine. Apply 01ZM to each structure morphism. Its base-change
tail has the original object as limit by 01YZ. Apply 01Z6 to obtain an affine stage,
then 07RP to obtain an étale stage. Further base changes remain affine and étale.
Directedness gives a common upper bound for the finite collection of stages; for
an empty collection use nonemptiness of I. Transitivity of pullbacks supplies
cartesian squares from the original objects to the common-stage models.

lean.statement:
theorem affineEtale_common_models
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ (i : Iᵒᵖ), CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i : Iᵒᵖ), QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (m : ℕ) (X : Fin m → c.pt.FullAffineEtale) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Xi : Fin m → (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
      ∀ a : Fin m, ∃ r : (X a).obj.left ⟶ (Xi a).obj.left,
        IsPullback r (X a).obj.hom (Xi a).obj.hom (c.π.app (op i))
